name: Dock Holiday

evidence.note: News story on a 2025 outdoor show: fans danced on the grass and one song set off a full dance party.
Band press kit says its mix of styles keeps crowds dancing.
Band calendar lists Oct 3, 4 PM at the Town of North Hempstead Fall Festival.

dancing.notes: A party cover band. A local paper reported fans dancing on the lawn and a full dance party during 'Uptown Funk' at a library concert.

description: A six-piece Long Island cover band with a female lead singer and sax that mixes funk, country, pop, rock and soul hits.
genres: funk, country, pop, rock and soul covers
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's List says North Hempstead Beach Park; the band calls it the Town of North Hempstead Fall Festival.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Booking email and phone are published by the band on its own site for bookings ("For booking please send Email", "Immediate Inquires Call"); the phone belongs to a band member. Current description and links are still accurate; the band site says it is from Northport. No logo recorded: the site's logo images are "Now Booking" promo graphics with lots of text (candidate: https://images.zoogletools.com/s:bzglfiles/u/595847/e40d3fb51cd7ed94f2184aac2799e78d7668ee9f/original/dh-logo-2026-low-res.jpg). Band-group promo shots on the site have large title text, so we used three clean member performance photos from the EPK instead.
